AI Overview
To use an original product photo and a marked-up reference image together for a targeted color edit, you should use a professional image editor like Adobe Photoshop or GIMP to isolate the change areas using layers and masks. The marked-up image acts as your blueprint, while the original photo serves as your canvas.
Here is the step-by-step workflow to achieve a precise, targeted color edit:
1. Set Up Your Workspace
Align the images: Open your original product photo in your editing software. Place the marked-up reference image on a separate layer directly above it.
Match the scale: If the reference image is a different size or crop, reduce its opacity to about 50% and use the transform tool to align it perfectly with the original.
Organize: Once aligned, hide the reference layer or keep it off to the side so you can toggle its visibility on and off as a guide.
